title: Universal SMP-Tweaks
description: Makes certain items immune to being destroyed by cacti
body:
This is an addon created for the [Lifesteal-Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/lifesteal-mian) intended for use inside the [Universal-SMP Modpack](https://modrinth.com/project/universal-smp-season-1)



Implemented Changes

 - Made the Revive Crystal and Heart Crystal immune to being destroyed when dropped on a cactus
